tax: Road use fee (annual road use certificate for private vehicles, by engine capacity)
statute: Road (Vehicle Use) Fee Act, 1998 (Act 556) s. 1, 2, 6 and Schedule (GhaLII text via Wayback 20260419091236, R4/fetch/p17/gh_act556_ghalii_wb20260419.html; GhaLII marks it as the latest version of the Act)
unsupported: the 2025 amounts are not established: the Schedule of 1998 gives private motor vehicles up to 2000 cc 20 000 cedis and above 2000 cc 30 000 cedis a year (old cedis, i.e. GH¢2 and GH¢3 after the 2007 redenomination), and s. 6 lets the Minister amend the Schedule by legislative instrument; no such instrument was located, so the 1998 amounts cannot be taken as the 2025 fee. The Energy Sector Levies Act, 2015 (Act 899) road fund levy is charged per litre of fuel (an excise on fuel, not a vehicle tax). Worked case under the 1998 Schedule (hand): a private car of 1 800 cc -> GH¢2 a year
tried: GhaLII search API; Act 556 via Wayback; no L.I. amending the Schedule found by GhaLII search
